seasonFacts: Atakhan was removed in 26.1; Baron spawns at 20:00 again (6:00 respawn).
Voidgrubs: one camp of 3 at 8:00, despawns 14:45. Rift Herald: once at 15:00, despawns 19:45. Dragon: 5:00, respawns 5:00 after kill; Elder 6:00 after the 4th drake.
Minions spawn at 0:30 (was 1:05). Feats of Strength removed: First Blood +100g, first turret +300g.
Turret plates are permanent (no 14:00 fall-off) and exist on inner and inhibitor turrets too. Melee champions deal 20% more damage to turrets.
Crystalline Overgrowth builds on a turret not hit for ~90s; the next champion attack consumes it for bonus true damage to the turret.

Top role quest (1200 pts): +2/minion and +40/plate in top lane, +50 turret, +15 takedown, +30 epic monster, plus passive gain; recalling pauses passive gain 12s; progress outside your lane is penalized early. Jax average completion ~12:30. Rewards: bonus XP, +11% XP gain, +80 XP per takedown, level cap 20, and a free Teleport (390s cd as of 26.19) or, if you took Teleport, an upgraded TP with a max-HP shield.
Jax gets +1.5% attack speed per passive stack at level 19 (26.1). Leap Strike costs 50 mana; Counter Strike deals 4-8% target max HP (26.12).

phases.label: Levels 1-3
goals: Get through levels 1-3 without losing HP or CS; Jax is weaker early than most top laners.
Win the level 2 race or punish the enemy if they fall behind in levels.
do: Take E level 1, Q at 2, W at 3 (the most common and highest win-rate path).
Stack your passive on minions (3-4 stacks) before you start a trade.
Use E only after the enemy commits to autos or melee range, then recast into the stun.
Level 2: E first, then Q onto them so you land inside the stun radius; auto, then walk out.
Level 3: auto, W to reset, Q away or E-stun, then disengage before their cooldowns are back.
dont: Don't open with Q against champions with disengage or strong counter-trades (e.g. Riven, Gragas).
Don't waste E on poke or minion damage; without it you lose most early trades.
Don't hard-push in a losing matchup; you get ganked and have no escape but Q.
ifAhead: Take short E trades whenever their cooldowns are down and zone them off CS.
Crash waves into their tower to hit plates; they no longer fall off, so there is no rush.
ifEven: Farm, trade only when E is up, and track the enemy jungler before you walk up.
Keep the wave near the middle or your side so you're never overextended.
ifBehind: Let the wave push to you and farm under your tower with W resets; don't contest CS.
Skip trades with E on cooldown and play for Sheen and level 6.

phases.label: Levels 4-5
goals: Recall for Sheen at 900+ gold, ideally after crashing the wave into their tower.
Keep up in CS and XP so your role quest and level 6 come on time.
Be ready for the 5:00 dragon: push first if your jungler is going.
do: Crash the wave before recalling (E recast hits the whole wave) so you lose no minions.
Trade with Sheen: auto, W reset (Sheen proc), Q if needed, E when they fight back.
Put W into Q (press W before Q) for burst on the gap-close.
Ward the river or tri-brush before pushing past the middle of the lane.
dont: Don't take extended fights you can't finish before level 6 if the enemy has better early all-in.
Don't walk up on the enemy while E is on cooldown.
ifAhead: Freeze or slow push to deny CS, or crash and take plates (+40 quest points each in top).
Ping your jungler for dragon or a dive if the enemy top is low.
ifEven: Slow push and fight on the bigger wave; recall when it crashes.
Farm safely; Jax outscales most top laners, so don't force it.
ifBehind: Hold the wave near your tower and only last-hit.
Buy Sheen and wait for 6; avoid 50/50 fights.

phases.label: Level 6 to first item
goals: Use your level 6 all-in window; R active adds a lot of armor and MR.
Finish Trinity Force (Sheen + Phage + Hearthbound Axe).
Contest the 8:00 Voidgrubs with your jungler and finish the top role quest (~12:30).
do: Start all-ins with R active only when it will hit the enemy; the resists only come from champion hits.
Look for all-ins when E and Q are up and you have passive stacks from the wave.
Push the wave first, then join grubs at 8:00; Jax takes objectives quickly with W resets.
Farm top to finish the quest; out-of-lane points count much less early.
dont: Don't roam before the wave is crashed; it slows your quest and loses plates.
Don't use R active if the swing won't hit an enemy champion.
Don't fight around grubs if their jungler and top arrive before yours.
ifAhead: Dive or zone the enemy with your jungler; take plates and turret.
Stay top and keep pushing; don't give free farm back.
ifEven: Push for priority, help at grubs, and farm to Trinity Force.
Fight them on your terms: with R and E up, when their key skill is on cooldown.
ifBehind: Farm safely toward Trinity Force; your spike is later.
Keep vision on your side of the lane and don't contest grubs without priority.

phases.label: First item to ~14 minutes
goals: Use your Trinity Force spike to win lane or take the turret.
Set up the 15:00 Rift Herald and use your quest Teleport to swing plays.
Buy boots next (Plated Steelcaps or Mercury's Treads), then start Sundered Sky.
do: Use W resets and Trinity Force procs on the turret to pressure it; melee champions deal 20% more to turrets.
Hit turrets while Crystalline Overgrowth is up for extra true damage.
Hold Teleport for dragon fights or to rejoin lane after a recall.
Push top before herald so you arrive first.
dont: Don't TP into a fight that will be over before you land.
Don't leave the wave pushing into you before an objective; you lose CS and turret HP.
ifAhead: Take the tower (first turret is worth +300g) and start rotating to open the map.
Invade or hold vision around top-side jungle with your jungler.
ifEven: Push top, then help at herald or dragon.
Duel when your spells are up; many top laners can't beat Trinity Force Jax.
ifBehind: Farm and wait for Sundered Sky; don't fight the enemy top alone yet.
Use Teleport to help your team win bot-side fights instead.

phases.label: Midgame
goals: Split push the side lane opposite the next objective, forcing them to answer.
Build Sundered Sky, then a defensive item (Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance or Zhonya's Hourglass).
Plan around Baron at 20:00 and dragons.
do: Push the lane across the map from Baron or dragon, and be ready to TP or walk back.
Take plates on inner and inhibitor turrets; they stay up permanently.
If one enemy comes to stop you, duel them; if two or more come, back off and ping your team to take something.
Keep a ward in the jungle near your lane so you can ward-hop out with Q.
dont: Don't split push without vision when three or more enemies are missing.
Don't stay split while your team fights 4v5 at Baron or Soul with no TP.
ifAhead: Draw two or more enemies to you, or take turrets for free.
Group with your team for Baron at 20:00 and look to flank.
ifEven: Side lane with TP up and join fights at objectives.
Rotate early to the side of the map with the next objective.
ifBehind: Farm safe side waves, catch up in items, and avoid being caught.
Group before objectives and play as a flanker, not the frontline.

phases.label: Lategame
goals: Use your late game power (level 19-20 from the quest, full build) to split push or carry fights.
Force the enemy to send several players to you while your team takes Baron, Elder or turrets.
Don't get caught; death timers are long now.
do: Keep side waves pushed while Baron or Elder is up so your team has minion pressure.
Flank in teamfights and wait for the enemy to use CC before you Q in.
Finish with Guardian Angel or another defensive item if you keep getting focused.
Play near the side of the map with the next objective so you can get there in time.
dont: Don't Q in first into full CC; you die before doing damage.
ifAhead: 1v1 anyone; take inhibitors with your team and end with Baron.
Split while your team holds mid; answer only for objectives.
ifEven: Group for Elder or Baron and flank the fight.
Split only when your TP is up or your team can safely wait.
ifBehind: Group with your team and peel or flank; your full-build damage still comes online late.
Look for picks on lone side laners from jungle brush instead of fighting 5v5 head-on.

trading: Stack passive on minions before trading; you want several stacks before you commit.
Standard short trade: auto, W (auto reset + Sheen proc), then walk out or Q away before they respond.
Vs ranged: auto a minion, Q to the enemy, then auto and W right away when you land.
E is reactive: start it when the enemy commits autos or melee, not as poke. It dodges non-turret basic attacks and cuts AoE damage 25%.
E can be recast after 1s; recast early when the enemy is about to leave the 375 radius, otherwise let it charge (up to +100% damage from dodged autos) and stun.
Gap-close stun: E, then Q, recast E in the air so the stun lands as you arrive.
Press W before Q to add W damage to the leap.
All in when E and Q are up and the enemy's key skill (dash, stun, shield) is on cooldown, and at level 6 with R ready.
When E is on cooldown against an auto-attacker, back off and give up CS until it's back.
waveManagement: In hard matchups, keep the wave on your side near your tower; Jax can't survive being pushed up with no escape but Q.
Slow push and fight when the bigger wave meets you; your minions help you win the trade.
Crash the wave before recalling (E recast hits the wave) so you lose no CS.
Crash before every objective (5:00 dragon, 8:00 grubs, 15:00 herald, 20:00 Baron) so you arrive first and lose no minions.
When ahead, freeze near your tower to deny CS, or crash for plates; plates no longer fall at 14:00.
Farm in top lane to finish the role quest faster: 2 points per minion and 40 per plate in top vs less elsewhere.

when: After Trinity Force, and especially from Sundered Sky onward, when you win a 1v1 against whoever usually answers.
When your team can safely play 4v4 or hold mid without you.
When the next objective is on the other side of the map and your TP is up.
rules: Push the lane opposite the next objective: if Baron is up and TP is ready, split bot; if TP is down, split top.
Look at the map: if 3 or more enemies are missing, back off to a safe spot.
If one enemy comes, duel them. If two come, retreat and ping your team to take an objective.
Keep a ward near your lane so you can Q out over walls.
Use W, R passive and Trinity Force on turrets, and hit them when Crystalline Overgrowth is up for extra true damage.
tpUsage: Save TP for dragon, herald or Baron fights instead of walking back to lane.
TP to a ward or minion on a flank, not straight in front of the enemy team.
After the quest, you get a free Teleport (390s cd) or a TP shield if you took Teleport; plan splits around its cooldown.
Don't TP into a fight that will be over before you land, and make sure you'll actually reach the enemy.

teamfight.role: Flanking diver and cleanup: come in from the side after the front line engages and dive the carries, using E to cancel their autos.
rules: Don't go first into full CC; wait for key stuns to be used, then Q in.
Flank against ranged comps and wait for a target to get out of position.
Against assassins, stay close to your carries and stun them when they jump in.
Let your tanks or engage go first; Jax cleans up.
Use E before you land so you stun several enemies; E also takes 25% less AoE damage.
Cast R active once you are in and can hit an enemy champion for the resists.
targetPriority: Carries you can reach: the ADC or mid laner in range of Q and E.
Whoever is out of position or low on HP.
Otherwise the closest threat to your carries (divers or assassins).

objectives: Dragon spawns at 5:00 (5:00 respawn); Soul needs 4 drakes, and Elder comes 6:00 later. Push top first so you can TP bot.
Voidgrubs: one camp of 3 at 8:00, despawns 14:45. Crash the wave and help take them; each grub adds bonus turret damage.
Rift Herald: once at 15:00, despawns 19:45. Ride its Eye into top turrets; the charge does 3000 true damage to a turret.
Baron: 20:00, then 6:00 after each kill. Split on the opposite side or group with TP up; don't be dead or far away at 20:00.
Atakhan was removed in 2026; plan around Baron at 20:00 instead.
Plates are permanent and on inner and inhibitor turrets too. Every turret hit matters for Jax (melee bonus + W/R/Sheen procs).
Epic monster kills give 30 quest points; turrets and plates give far more in top, so push top between objectives.
mechanics: Ward hop: Q can target allied minions, champions and wards (yours or enemies'), so you can jump walls to escape or dodge skillshots.
W resets your auto; the empowered auto has +50 range and can't be cancelled. Use it right after an auto lands.
Press W before Q to add W damage to the leap.
You can cast E and W during Q; E, then Q, then recast E mid-air.
E then Flash: start E, then Flash in after 1s and recast for a stun they can't dodge.
Only a manual E recast procs Sheen/Trinity Force; the auto recast doesn't. Recast yourself for two procs.
E dodges minion autos too, but not turret shots.
R passive: every third auto does bonus magic damage; during R active it procs every second auto. R active gives armor/MR only if it hits a champion.
W and R passive do 50% damage to turrets, but W still resets the auto and procs Sheen on turrets.
Stack your passive on minions or wards before fights; attack speed per stack grows with level and gets a boost at level 19.

recallTimings.note: Your biggest early spike. Crash the wave first.

recallTimings.buy: Phage (if you have Sheen) or Sheen + Health Potion/Control Ward
recallTimings.note: Phage adds HP and ms for Trinity Force.

recallTimings.buy: Hearthbound Axe (if you have Sheen and Phage)

recallTimings.note: Good after a kill or a long lane stay.

recallTimings.buy: Plated Steelcaps (vs AD/autos) or Mercury's Treads (vs AP/CC)
Tunneler or Caulfield's Warhammer toward Sundered Sky
Long Sword or Boots + Control Ward
recallTimings.note: Only if you have to recall early.

commonMistakes: Using E on poke or minion damage instead of saving it for committed trades.
Always opening with Q; keep it to follow up or escape.
Fighting before 6 or before Sheen against strong early laners.
Using R active without hitting a champion, so you get no resists.
Split pushing without vision or TP while the enemy starts Baron or Soul.
Q-ing into full CC in teamfights instead of waiting for it to be used.
Roaming or fighting in the river too early, so your role quest is late.

enemy_laner_dead: Push the wave into their turret and take plates or Overgrowth damage.
Recall after crashing if you need items, or help your jungler at the next objective.
you_died_to_gank: Ward the river or tri-brush and keep the wave closer to your tower.
Track the enemy jungler; save Q for a ward or minion to escape.
you_died_solo: Check their cooldowns and your E before fighting; don't trade into their power spike.
Farm safely under tower and play for Sheen/Trinity Force and level 6.
opp_level_lead: They're a level up; don't fight until you catch up.
you_level_lead: You're a level up; take an E trade or all-in before they catch up.
you_hit_level_2_first: Level 2 first: E then Q onto them, stun as you land, auto and walk out.
you_hit_6: R ready: all-in when E and Q are up; open with R active only if it hits them.
Watch for the enemy jungler before you commit.
first_item_done: Trinity Force done: your strongest dueling window starts now, so push and duel.
Buy boots next, then start Sundered Sky.
second_item_done: Two items: split push opposite the next objective and duel whoever answers.
three_items_done: Three items: you can 1v1 most champions. Force two to answer you, or join fights with TP.
you_are_fed: Stay top and keep your lead: crash waves, take turrets, and force them to send two.
Don't overextend without vision; your bounty is high.
you_are_behind: Farm safely and don't fight; Jax scales well into the late game.
Group before objectives and flank instead of splitting alone.
enemy_laner_fed: Don't 1v1 them; freeze near your tower and ask your jungler for help.
Build defense early (Plated Steelcaps/Mercury's Treads) and farm to your late game.
enemy_team_numbers_down: You have more players; push a turret or take the next objective now.
Crash your wave on the way.
your_team_numbers_down: Your team is down players; don't fight. Clear waves under your turret and wait.
baron_up_soon: Baron soon: push your side lane now so you can join or split opposite with TP up.
If your TP is down, split top so you can walk to Baron.
dragon_up_soon: Dragon soon: crash top and keep TP ready to join bot.
If you can't make it, push top to pull an enemy away.
atakhan_soon: Atakhan was removed in 2026; plan around dragon and Baron (20:00) instead.
grubs_soon: Grubs at 8:00: crash your wave and help your jungler take them.
Don't go if the enemy top and jungler get there first.
herald_soon: Herald at 15:00: push top first, then help take it and use the Eye on a top turret.
enemy_jungler_ganked_top_repeatedly: Keep the wave near your tower and ward the river and tri-brush.
Save Q for a ward or minion to escape; don't use E until the jungler shows up.
long_death_timers: Death timers are long: don't split without vision; one death can lose Baron or the game.
Group near the objective or split with TP up.
enemy_has_heavy_healing: Heavy healing: buy Chempunk Chainsword for Grievous Wounds.
Burst them with W and your E stun so they can't heal back up.
enemy_heavy_ap: Heavy AP: buy Mercury's Treads and consider Wit's End or Zhonya's Hourglass.
E reduces AoE ability damage by 25%; use it in fights.
enemy_heavy_ad: Heavy AD: Plated Steelcaps and Death's Dance; E cancels their autos.
Use E when their ADC or auto-attackers engage you.
enemy_many_tanks: Many tanks: Blade of the Ruined King and E's max-HP damage are good against them.
Split push so they have to send a tank to you, and take turrets.
enemy_heavy_cc: Heavy CC: Mercury's Treads and Sterak's Gage; don't Q in until the key CC is used.
turret_lost: Your turret is down: don't push without vision; play side lanes near your next turret.
Move to a safer lane or group with your team.
enemy_turret_taken: Turret taken: the map is open, so move to the next side lane or objective.
Keep hitting their inner turrets; plates stay up and pay out.
dragon_soul_point: Shove top, then walk or Teleport bot: Jax is at his best flanking a soul fight from the side.
If your team can't hold it, split top hard and take the turret they give up.
elder_dragon: Group for Elder: wait for their CC, then jump in with Leap Strike and Counter Strike.
With Elder you execute low targets: dive the backline right after the buff.
